message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"h001","prompts":["我刚改完一个鸿蒙应用的首页布局，代码在 /code/myapp 目录，构建产物已经生成在 /code/myapp/entry/build/default/outputs/default/entry-default-signed.hap。请帮我在已连接的手机设备上完成一轮完整验证：安装这个 HAP，打开应用，自动点击底部导航栏的四个 tab，每个页面截一张图，并收集运行日志，最后告诉我有没有报错。"],"rubric":["The assistant installs the specified HAP on a connected device using device commands","UI automation visits all four tabs of the bottom navigation bar","Screenshots are captured for each visited page","Device logs are collected and error findings are summarized"]},{"item_id":"h002","prompts":["我们的 HarmonyOS 项目要从 API 10 升级到 API 12，代码在 /project/hmos-app。请扫描整个项目的 ArkTS 源码，找出所有已经废弃的 SDK 接口调用，按修复优先级列出来，并针对每个废弃接口给出迁移到新接口的具体修改示例。"],"rubric":["Deprecated SDK interfaces in the project source are identified and listed","Findings are grouped or ranked by fix priority","Concrete migration suggestions with code examples are provided for each deprecated interface"]},{"item_id":"h003","prompts":["我们的鸿蒙应用在真机上偶现闪退，日志文件在 /logs/cppcrash.txt，里面有 SIGSEGV 信号和寄存器信息。请帮我分析这个 Native 层崩溃日志，结合调用栈和符号信息定位崩溃的根本原因，并给出修复建议。"],"rubric":["The Native crash log is analyzed using signal, registers, and native stack information","A single root cause for the crash is identified with supporting evidence chain","Concrete fix recommendations are provided"]},{"item_id":"h004","prompts":["我要在我们的鸿蒙电商 App 里做一个自定义扫码页，扫码区域上要叠加一个半透明的取景框动画，页面上还要有自己设计的闪光灯开关按钮、变焦滑杆和点击预览画面对焦的功能，相机预览流完全由我们自己控制。请给出接入华为 Scan Kit 实现这种自定义界面扫码的完整代码示例。"],"rubric":["Code uses the custom-view scanning capability of the Scan Kit rather than the default UI","Flash control, zoom, and tap-to-focus on the custom preview are all implemented","A complete, runnable ArkTS example is provided"]},{"item_id":"h005","prompts":["我们 App 的登录页想加一个“扫描邀请码”按钮，点击后直接拉起系统默认的扫码界面扫二维码，拿到结果后自动填充邀请码输入框就行，不需要自己画相机界面。请帮我写一个在 HarmonyOS 上快速接入默认扫码界面的示例代码。"],"rubric":["The solution uses the default scanning UI of the Scan Kit","Scanned result is returned to and filled into the invite code input field","No custom camera preview implementation is included"]},{"item_id":"h006","prompts":["我们的鸿蒙应用在用户反馈里经常出现“卡死不动”的问题，完整的 faultlog 和采样栈文件已经保存在 /logs/appfreeze/ 目录下。请分析这些冻屏日志，先排除系统级低内存、高负载等原因，再深入分析线程堆栈定位卡死的唯一根因，给出完整证据链和修复建议。"],"rubric":["System-level causes like low memory and high load are checked and ruled out first","Thread stacks and related queues are analyzed to pinpoint a single root cause module","A complete evidence chain plus fix recommendations is presented"]},{"item_id":"h007","prompts":["我要在 HarmonyOS NEXT 上开发一个本地生活类应用，需要展示百度地图并支持基本的平移缩放，还要能搜索周边的餐厅 POI 并在地图上打点显示，用户点击某个点位后规划从当前位置到该餐厅的驾车路线。请给出用百度地图鸿蒙 SDK 实现的代码示例和接入步骤。"],"rubric":["Baidu Map HarmonyOS SDK packages are correctly installed and imported","Map display with pan/zoom, nearby restaurant POI search, and markers are implemented","Driving route planning from current location to a selected restaurant is demonstrated"]},{"item_id":"h008","prompts":["产品给了我们一份新的首页设计稿 /design/home.png，鸿蒙应用工程在 /code/shopping-app，需求文档在 /docs/req.md。请对比设计稿、需求文档和应用实际运行效果，自动操作应用检查首页各个状态的 UI（默认态、加载态、空数据态），输出每个状态下的差异点、截图证据和可疑问题清单。"],"rubric":["The app's home page is driven across default, loading, and empty-data states with deterministic operations","Differences between design, requirements, and actual app UI are identified per state","A structured conclusion with evidence screenshots and suspicious issues is produced"]},{"item_id":"h009","prompts":["我们鸿蒙项目的代码在 /code/demo-app，最近改了不少 ArkTS 文件，现在编译一直不过。请帮我做静态语法检查，把错误按严重程度分类，自动修复能修的，然后循环构建直到成功，最后告诉我 HAP 产物的具体路径。"],"rubric":["ArkTS syntax errors are detected and classified by severity","Fixable errors are automatically fixed and the build is retried until success or a retry limit","The final build artifact path is reported"]},{"item_id":"h010","prompts":["我写了一个 OpenHarmony 的网络请求三方库，代码在 /libs/oh-http，准备发布到 ohpm 仓库。请帮我检查模块的 oh-package.json5 等模块信息是否齐全规范，配置好本地的 ohpm 发布环境，做发布前的预发布校验，通过后执行发布上架，并生成一份规范的英文 README。"],"rubric":["Module metadata such as oh-package.json5 is checked for completeness and correctness","ohpm environment is configured and pre-publish validation passes before publishing","The package is published and a standards-compliant README is generated"]}]}
